instruction: Turn on automatic screen dimming when idle on my Ubuntu system to save power.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling automatic screen dimming. Setup disables idle-dim (false), agent must enable it (true). Uses existing vm_command_line getter and exact_match metric. Verified: gsettings returns 'true\n' when enabled.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses vm_command_line getter to execute 'gsettings get org.gnome.settings-daemon.plugins.power idle-dim' command
Metric exact_match appropriately checks for boolean gsettings value
Expected value 'true\n' correctly represents the enabled state with proper newline formatting
Complete coverage: single-step task (enable idle-dim) is fully verified by checking the gsettings value
Data flow is correct: getter extracts idle-dim setting → metric performs exact string match → expected value matches gsettings output format
No state accessibility issues: gsettings value is persistent and accessible via command line execution
Setup correctly initializes disabled state (idle-dim=false) and evaluator verifies enabled state (idle-dim=true)
